Indian Company Achieves World's First AI Management System Standard

Quadrasystems.net has become one of the first entities in India to achieve the ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification. This standard is the world's first international benchmark for Artificial Intelligence Management Systems. The achievement signifies a step towards formalizing AI governance and management practices within the country.
